cards.name: Vampiric Touch
cards.designIntent: Maintain a distinct DoT to deal delayed damage and support Insanity generation.

base.text: Apply Touch: 5 damage for 3 turns. Ticks before the enemy acts. Reapplying refreshes.
effects: Apply Touch: 5 damage for 3 turns. Ticks before the enemy acts. Reapplying refreshes.

upgrade.summary: +1 damage per tick and +1 turn (15 total becomes 24).

card.text: Apply Touch: 6 damage for 4 turns. Ticks before the enemy acts. Reapplying refreshes.
effects: Apply Touch: 6 damage for 4 turns. Ticks before the enemy acts. Reapplying refreshes.

rulesNotes: Ticks before the enemy acts, then loses one turn; no immediate tick on application.
Reapplication replaces damage AND duration with the played card's values; values do not stack.
HP-loss ticks bypass Block and ignore Strength, Weak, Vulnerable and Voidform. Enemy damage hooks such as Intangible still apply.
Each of Touch and Pain counts as one unique DoT for Insanity. Ticks do not generate Insanity.
cards.balanceNotes: Prototype values; balance is subject to playtesting.

cards.name: Enter Voidform
cards.designIntent: Hold the earned activation until a strong burst turn.

effects: Spend this card's ready charge and enter Voidform until the player's turn ends.

rulesNotes: Generated when the starter relic reaches 10 Insanity; not a permanent starter or reward.
One pending charge at a time. Full hands defer delivery. Copied or recovered cards cannot reuse a spent charge.
Voidform reduces Attack energy costs by 1 (minimum 0; excludes X-cost) and multiplies Attack damage by 1.5.
Insanity stops accumulating while ready or active; it resets when Voidform ends and after combat.
cards.balanceNotes: Prototype values; balance is subject to playtesting.
